title: A Language-Informed Loss for Visual Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23653v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: End-to-end visual generation with pixel-space loss has recently achieved competitive performance without the need for learned image tokenizers. In this work, we study whether language-informed supervision can provide a richer training signal than pixel loss for visual generation. We introduce LILIE (pronounced "lily"), a Language-Informed and Lossless Image Encoder. LILIE is an invertible image transform trained such that a vision-language model can recover captions from noised features. The encoder uses a normalizing flow transformer trained jointly with a vision-language model via next token prediction. We then use the encoder to extract a simple language-informed loss for text-to-image generation. We train JiT models with LILIE loss, reducing gFD by 14 points (66.84 $\to$ 53.01) against a pixel-only baseline on the GPIC dataset. Our code, encoders, and generative models are available at https://suchiragarwal.com/lilie.

translated_title: 一种面向视觉生成的语言信息引导损失
translated_abstract: 基于像素空间损失的端到端视觉生成方法近期在无需学习型图像分词器的情况下已取得了具有竞争力的性能。在本工作中，我们研究语言信息引导的监督信号能否为视觉生成提供比像素损失更丰富的训练信号。我们提出了LILIE（发音为"lily"），一种语言信息引导且无损的图像编码器。LILIE是一种可逆的图像变换，其训练目标是使视觉-语言模型能够从加噪特征中恢复出图像描述（caption）。该编码器采用归一化流变换器，通过下一词元预测与视觉-语言模型联合训练。随后，我们利用该编码器提取一种简单的语言信息引导损失，用于文本到图像的生成。我们使用LILIE损失训练JiT模型，在GPIC数据集上相比仅使用像素损失的基线，将gFD降低了14个点（66.84 → 53.01）。我们的代码、编码器和生成模型已发布于 https://suchiragarwal.com/lilie。
tldr: 提出LILIE，一种通过归一化流变换器与视觉-语言模型联合训练的可逆图像编码器，可从中提取语言信息引导损失用于文生图训练，相比纯像素损失基线将gFD降低14个点。
en_tdlr: Introduces LILIE, an invertible image encoder jointly trained with a vision-language model via normalizing flows, which provides a language-informed loss that improves text-to-image generation by 14 gFD points over pixel-only baselines.
